evaluations.evidence: create a new game by entering a name and an optional description
evaluations.rationale: No other story expresses the same requirement or is a superset/subset of this exact create-game action and data.

evaluations.evidence: invite estimators by giving them a URL where they can access the game
evaluations.rationale: No other story duplicates the specific mechanism of inviting via a URL.

evaluations.evidence: start a round by entering an item in a single multi-line text field
evaluations.rationale: This specific UI interaction for starting a round is not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Moderator-facing requirement to view session items is not duplicated by another moderator story.

evaluations.evidence: select an item to be estimated or re-estimated
evaluations.rationale: Substantially duplicates PP-013 (re-estimating an earlier story) without a meaningful difference in actor or goal.

evaluations.evidence: add an item to the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Adding items during play is not duplicated elsewhere with same actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: edit an item in the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Editing items is a distinct requirement not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: delete an item from the list of items to be estimated
evaluations.rationale: Deleting items is a distinct action not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: show all estimates immediately ... even though not all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: This early-reveal capability is materially different from other reveal-timing stories.

evaluations.evidence: accept the average of all estimates
evaluations.rationale: Deciding to accept an average is a unique business-rule action not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: "estimate" field filled in automatically if all estimators show the same card
evaluations.rationale: Automatic acceptance when unanimous is a distinct automation requirement.

evaluations.evidence: enter the agreed-upon estimate
evaluations.rationale: Manual entry of agreed estimate is not duplicated by other stories.

evaluations.evidence: estimate a story we estimated earlier in the session again
evaluations.rationale: Substantially contained in / duplicates PP-005 (select an item to be estimated or re-estimated) with the same actor and goal.

evaluations.evidence: import stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Importing stories via spreadsheet is a distinct ingestion mechanism not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: copy/paste stories from a spreadsheet
evaluations.rationale: Copy/paste is a different method than import and is not duplicated identically elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: browse through previous games
evaluations.rationale: Browsing previous games is a distinct navigation feature not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: view a transcript of a game
evaluations.rationale: Viewing a transcript (moderator-facing) is not duplicated by other stories in the same actor/context.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a HTML file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-HTML is a specific output-format requirement distinct from other exports.

evaluations.evidence: export a transcript of a game as a CSV file
evaluations.rationale: Export-as-CSV is a separate format-specific requirement; format difference is a meaningful distinction.

evaluations.evidence: delete a game
evaluations.rationale: Deleting a game is not duplicated by another story with the same actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: create an account ... name, email address, a password and a username
evaluations.rationale: Account creation with specific fields is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: log in using my account name and password
evaluations.rationale: Login is a distinct requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: change my account details
evaluations.rationale: Account modification is a separate requirement.

evaluations.evidence: delete my account
evaluations.rationale: Account deletion is distinct from game deletion and account management stories.

evaluations.evidence: see dates and times in my local timezone
evaluations.rationale: Timezone display requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: get a password reminder by email
evaluations.rationale: Password reminder via email is a distinct authentication recovery requirement.

evaluations.evidence: select whether to have the team estimate with {0, 1/2, 1, 2, ...} or {0, 1, 2, 4, ...}
evaluations.rationale: Selecting a scoring scale is a unique configuration requirement.

evaluations.evidence: invite up to 15 estimators
evaluations.rationale: A numerical limit on invitees is a unique constraint requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: join a game by entering my name on the page I received the URL for
evaluations.rationale: Join-by-name via URL is distinct from invitation mechanism and other join stories.

evaluations.evidence: see the item we're estimating
evaluations.rationale: Participant view of the current item is not duplicated by another participant story with same detail.

evaluations.evidence: see all items we will try to estimate this session
evaluations.rationale: Estimator-facing listing of session items differs from moderator's similar story by actor.

evaluations.evidence: immediately see that an estimate has been given by a specific estimator
evaluations.rationale: Indicator that someone has submitted an estimate (before reveal) is different from stories about showing estimates or identities with estimates.

evaluations.evidence: be shown all estimates at the same time after all estimators have given their estimate
evaluations.rationale: Reveal-at-once behavior is distinct from early reveal or identity-display stories.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate up until the last person selects a card and all are shown
evaluations.rationale: Expresses the same requirement as PP-041 (change estimate until draw completion) with no meaningful difference in actor/context/goal.

evaluations.evidence: see each estimator's prior estimates for the story being estimated
evaluations.rationale: Request to view each estimator's prior estimates for the current story is not duplicated elsewhere in same detail.

evaluations.evidence: see who gave what estimates during the current round
evaluations.rationale: Displaying identities alongside estimates during current-round discussion is a specific requirement distinct from other estimate-notification stories.

evaluations.evidence: start a two-minute countdown timer that all participants can see
evaluations.rationale: Ability to start a shared timer is distinct from timer reset or other timing stories.

evaluations.evidence: two-minute timer reset itself as soon as we all play an estimate
evaluations.rationale: Automatic reset behavior is a distinct timer-related requirement.

evaluations.evidence: scroll back through the stories and estimates from prior rounds
evaluations.rationale: In-session navigation to prior rounds is distinct from exporting or viewing full transcripts; not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: always have the cards in the same order across multiple draws
evaluations.rationale: Card-order consistency across draws is a unique UI requirement.

evaluations.evidence: change my estimate as long as the draw has not been completed
evaluations.rationale: Duplicates PP-034 (change estimate up until last person selects) with the same actor/context/goal and no meaningful difference.

evaluations.evidence: have a small thumbnail photo displayed near where my cards are played
evaluations.rationale: Displaying a thumbnail near played cards is a specific UI personalization requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have written a site which is compliant with XHTML and CSS standards
evaluations.rationale: Standards compliance for markup/styles is a distinct developer requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have a list of definitions for commonly used terms
evaluations.rationale: Maintaining a definitions list is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: have created database indexes
evaluations.rationale: Database indexing as an implementation/performance task is not duplicated by any other story specifying the same developer action.

evaluations.evidence: application function correctly in Internet Explorer 6 and 7, Firefox 1.5 and 2, and Safari 2
evaluations.rationale: Specific browser compatibility requirements are unique and not repeated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: site comply with the W3C accessibility guidelines where possible
evaluations.rationale: Accessibility compliance is a distinct non-functional requirement.

evaluations.evidence: have the application respond quickly to my actions
evaluations.rationale: General responsiveness is a distinct user-perceived performance requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to use Unicode
evaluations.rationale: Unicode support is a specific internationalization requirement not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: see sensible and predictable URLs
evaluations.rationale: URL design requirement is unique in the backlog.

evaluations.evidence: have nice error pages when something goes wrong
evaluations.rationale: Error-page quality requirement is distinct and not duplicated elsewhere.

evaluations.evidence: results to be stored in a non-identifiable way
evaluations.rationale: Anonymized storage for research is a distinct privacy/research requirement.

evaluations.evidence: be able to see some metrics on use of the game
evaluations.rationale: Metrics/analytics request is unique and not duplicated elsewhere.
